variables.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the astronaut in <Picture 1>, in a white hard-shell suit with a gold-mirrored visor, an orange chest harness and a soft-sided life-support pack.
<Video 1> is the camera and staging reference for the target video: a wide backlit shot of a lone hiker standing in profile on a rocky outcrop above a layered mountain range at sunset, the sun low behind the ridge, the figure held in near silhouette on the right of frame with the valley falling away to the left.

summary:
[image subject reference + video camera and staging reference] The target video places <Subject 1> into the shot described by <Video 1>: the astronaut stands in profile on the same clifftop at sunset, framed and lit the way <Video 1> frames and lights its hiker, and speaks one line to the horizon.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the suit, visor, harness and proportions of <Picture 1> are kept exactly, with the body newly posed standing in profile and the head newly animated to speak.
<Video 1>: reference - only its framing, its backlit sunset lighting, its clifftop-and-mountains setting and its slow held camera are referenced; its hiker is replaced by <Subject 1> and none of its frames are reused.

detailed_description:
The target video is in realistic photographic style. [Shot 1] A wide shot frames <Subject 1> standing in profile on a rocky outcrop on the right of frame, facing left toward a layered range of mountains that recedes into haze, exactly the staging of <Video 1>. The sun sits low and just behind the ridge, so the astronaut is held in near silhouette with a hard warm rim running down the back of the suit and a broad flare washing across the gold visor; the valley falls away to the left in bands of shadow and gold. <Subject 1> stands still with his weight on his back foot, then turns his head a few degrees toward the sun. <Subject 1> (S1), a measured, formal male voice, mid-range in pitch, says <d>[English] We have come a long way, and the way ahead is longer still.</d> As the line ends he lifts his chin and holds his gaze on the horizon, one gloved hand settling onto the chest harness. The camera holds a static shot with a very slight drift throughout, matching the held camera of <Video 1>.

overall_soundscape:
A broad, open, high-altitude room tone with a steady low wind moving across the microphone and gusting once as he turns his head. The suit fabric and harness give a dry creak as his glove meets his chest, and a faint regulator hiss cycles quietly under the dialogue from the first frame to the last.

non_diegetic_music:
A slow, sparse orchestral bed of sustained low strings under a single held horn note, mixed well beneath the voice, swelling gently as he turns toward the sun and settling back into stillness at the end of the clip.
